provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: One host has two independent NONEQUIVALENT ligand sites. Free ligand concentration L is externally buffered, so no depletion equation is needed. Site occupancy theta_i=K_i*L/(1+K_i*L); total site fractional occupancy Y=(theta_A+theta_B)/2. There is no coupling between sites.
hill_definition: The local slope n_H=d ln[Y/(1-Y)]/d ln L at Y=1/2. It is not the exponent of an assumed global Hill fit. Differentiate the actual sum of two Langmuir occupancies or use an independently justified derivative.
scope: Controlled binding heterogeneity. A slope below1 can occur without negative cooperativity and does not count sites. No microscopic binding mechanism or real host design is inferred.
